content.text: Worked as a student assistant alongside 60 other students from across the US for an entire week with the Esri team to help organize the largest GIS conference, with 20,000+ participants.

sections.heading: Forum on AI and Data Science for Agriculture

content.text: Presented a poster titled ‘LULC change of South Asia using the Random Forest Machine Learning Technique’ on April 21, 2025 at the AU Hotel.
Presented on Heat Vulnerability Index and Climate Policies on Chattogram City at the American Association of Geographers (AAG) 2025 annual meeting in Detroit.
Presented on Urban Heat Island, LULC Change and Heat Action Plans of South Asia at the American Geophysical Union (AGU) annual conference in DC.
Presented a lightning talk on Climate Policies and Social Justice of South Asia at Columbia Climate School in New York City in November 2024.
The team presented on the energy demand-based GHG mitigation of Jahangirnagar University at the Bangabandhu Chair Closing Ceremony in Thailand, invited by Prof. Joyashree Roy.
Attended as a Global Talent participant at UNLEASH with 1000 other participants to find solutions related to the SDGs. The team worked on waste management (SDG 13 - Climate Action).
Presented on Post-disaster Recovery of Bangladesh at the Disaster Resilience and Sustainable Development Symposium at the Asian Institute of Technology, Thailand.
Attended the summer school on Geoinformatics for Sustainable Agriculture organized by RSGIS FoS at the Asian Institute of Technology, Thailand, with participants from 9 Asian countries.
